rows.grounds: dvādaśa = 'twelve' (numeral), vāha = 'stream/flow' (m.), udaya = 'arising' (m.); instrumental singular ending -ena; gloss: 'by the arising of the twelve streams'
mahā = 'great' (prefix/adjectival member), marīci = 'ray' (m./f.), vikāsa = 'expansion' (m.); nominative singular ending -aḥ; gloss: 'the expansion of the great rays'
